changes: p3 Śyāmasundara: role 'owner' removed. 'śyāmasūndarayāṃ tithi' seems to mean 'on the tithi of Śyāmasundara' (Newari genitive -yā), not 'his book'. Role changed to 'other' at low confidence; he may not be a human connected with this copy.
Removed the wrote_for relation p1→p3 because the colophon does not support it.
p1: confidence lowered to medium. The doubled 'śrīsrī' allows either Śrīnātharāma (catalogue reading, kept) or Nātharāma with a doubled honorific.
Date checked: NS 959 Mārgaśira śukla 5, roja 5 = Thursday. Mārgaśira of NS 959 falls in late 1838 CE, so ce_approx 1838 stands.

notes: "'jikhitaṃ' is an error for 'likhitaṃ'. 'śrīsrīnātharāmena' may be read as Śrīnātharāma (the catalogue's reading) or as śrīśrī + Nātharāma. 'kushe' is probably the Newari personal name Kuśe (father of the scribe). 'śyāmasūndarayāṃ tithi' is unclear. It may mark the day as a tithi connected with Śyāmasundara: perhaps a person's śrāddha or anniversary, or the epithet of Kṛṣṇa, which would make it a deity. It is not an ownership statement. The weekday 'roja 5' = Thursday."
